scenes.text: The heatwave ends. The debt doesn't.
A street vendor can't stop to rest. Stopping means losing the day's sales.
Then the heat makes him ill. Days of work are lost, and treatment costs money.
A loan fills the gap. Now, on the next hot day, rest costs even more.
Heat, lost income, debt, no rest. Shade, paid rest and income support could make rest possible, if they reach people in time.
See what could break the cycle. Beat the heat dot Asia.
